mostWorthwhile.text: Transferring the cooler to monitored reserve power was the strongest payoff: the check confirmed the setup worked, and Eli's relief made it matter.

leastWorthwhile.text: Connecting the backup unit and then the battery felt a little drawn out, even though the distinction between a circuit and a power source was clear.

surprise.text: The load measurement needed to account for cycling peaks, not just the average; the reserve estimate also changed if another load was added.

arbitrary.text: Combining the reserve estimate with the switch felt slightly arbitrary: I understood the broader purpose, but wasn't sure why those two objects would isolate the circuits.

continue.text: Yes, probably. The practical checks and the clinic's stakes made me curious what happens after this temporary reserve arrangement, though the sequential setup could feel repetitive.
